itens.titulo: TSMC CEO Hints Company Could Back Up Customers If Intel’s Advanced Packaging Ramp-Up Falls Short
itens.descricao: TSMC CEO Hints Company Could Back Up Customers If Intel’s Advanced Packaging Ramp-Up Falls Short Yahoo Finance
trechos: - Wei said TSMC is already producing advanced packages at 5x reticle size with "excellent" yields, which has kept customers satisfied.
"I try to avoid answering it directly, but let me say that, yes, we will be," Wei said.
"Number one priority I already indicated is that TSMC's customer's product can be introduced into the market smoothly.

And that gives you enough of a hint." TSM stock fell nearly 4% in morning trade amid broader market weakness as concerns around AI spending and hotter-than-expected producer prices weighed on markets.
Platform data showed a 666% increase in chatter in the same time period.

During Intel's second-quarter (Q2) earnings call in July, CEO Lip-Bu Tan stated that EMIB-T orders were growing and yield and reliability targets were being met, with the company preparing to scale production to support customers' 2027 ramps.
INTC stock fell over 5% in morning trade on Thursday.
